recommendation: Keep the core audit as-is. If a future review finds a missing generated cross-version package artifact for Observation.valueAttachment in R4, handle that in the cross-version/extension packaging workflow, not by changing current core Observation source.
issue_request: FHIR-24695 was an Applied/Persuasive OO change request for Observation, raised against STU3 and applied for R6. It requested defining an Observation valueAttachment extension for R4 use and documenting when to use Observation.valueAttachment, Observation.derivedFrom, and DiagnosticReport.presentedForm.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-24695 was found. The same valueAttachment change family is represented by FHIR-24693 commit 0acff97ca003816dc9ddb57f84c591cffbd84666, which added valueAttachment to Observation notes and added the usage guidance; later source rework carried Attachment into the active Observation.value[x] StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. Current Observation notes and StructureDefinition source already include valueAttachment/Attachment guidance, and source/versions.html documents the standard cross-version extension package mechanism. The local FHIR Extension Pack checkout does not contain a bespoke Observation.valueAttachment extension, matching the interpretation that R4 use is covered by inter-version infrastructure rather than a core source file.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the active core source already provides the requested guidance and a core-local extension definition would duplicate or bypass the cross-version extension approach.
